reply_text:
I replied to Hollis in the DM to confirm the change: from now on, Bay 25 is his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Ashgrove project.

I didn't add a separate note to the brain. The brain already saves this DM as a fact that only Hollis can see. Its manual "remember" tool has a visibility setting, but I couldn't tell how it works, and a new note might have been visible to more people. Relying on the automatic save keeps his note private, as rule 2 requires. I haven't posted it anywhere else.
